coaching.headline: A 30-11 five-stack win built on the 19.2 Fangtooth wipe (5-0) and a clean late game — Primal and Orb both banked at 32-33.
coaching.team: We took every major from 13 minutes on: Mini Prime 13, Fangtooth 20 and 25, Genesis 23, Primal 32, Orb 33. The mid-game fights did it — 5-0 at our Fangtooth at 19.2, then 2-0s at 22.1 and 24.5, and the 4-0 at Primal at 32. What a better team punishes: the 8.2 bad trade (0-2 deep in our half with three of us absent) and giving their Fangtooth at 12 on a cross-map trade. Five of five won fights should cash; three did.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 19.2-minute 5-0 wipe at our Fangtooth broke the game open, and the 32-minute 4-0 at Primal banked Primal plus Orb in one window.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Murdock went 10/1/3 in the offlane with 20k objective damage — the game's engine. The one blemish is instructive: the single death, caught alone by Wukong at 29.8, still cost the inner tower at 30.7. Even at 10-and-0, a solo death buys the enemy a building.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Gideon finished 6/0/7 — a deathless mid. The lane read slid late (theirs by the last checkpoints) but it never showed on the scoreboard. At the 8.2 bad trade the macro shows mid ahead and un-rotated; with the rest of the game this clean, that early shove-and-rotate is the last habit to add.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Kallari owned the jungle all game — 8/2 with 32k objective damage, the most on the team. That objective damage is exactly what converted the fight wins into the 13-to-33-minute major streak. Vision was 4 wards this time; keep building it.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Mourn's 22 wards carried the map's vision, and 0/4/11 is the support line the team needed. Two of the four deaths were the 8.2 bad trade deep in our half and the 10.9 death that preceded their Fangtooth — both fights the team chose badly, worth vetoing from the support seat.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Eden put up 5/4 with 15.5k objective damage. The early game was the rough patch — caught at 4.1 by Wukong and part of the 8.2 bad trade. The build sat off the Solaris and Nuclear Rounds pieces of the meta core; on-core, the mid-game fights get cheaper.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Howitzer Land Mine (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Maco. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought none.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Mourn Abduct (pull). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Mourn) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
ourKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
ourKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
ourKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
ourKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

ourKits.combo: Shadow Walk stealth → Crippling Dagger slow → Shadow Dance gap-close → Guillotine execute ult
ourKits.winCondition: stealth-pick an isolated squishy and execute with Guillotine
ourKits.passive: Death Mark detonates for bonus burst
ourKits.playWith: a team that follows her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: ward/reveal for the stealth; she's the squishiest hero — any CC kills her

ourKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
ourKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
ourKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
ourKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion

ourKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
ourKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
ourKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
ourKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
ourKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

enemyKits.combo: Maco Gift! (heal ally / hurt enemy) → Maco Fly! slam → Maco Strike! charged line ult
enemyKits.winCondition: poke and heal-flex while landing the charged ult
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the charged Strike; pressure his low survivability

enemyKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
enemyKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
enemyKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

enemyKits.combo: Windsurge engage → Cyclebreaker damage-reduction spin → clones from 84000 Hairs
enemyKits.winCondition: stance-dance for damage or tankiness and overwhelm with clones
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights alongside his clones
enemyKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; CC him during the damage-reduction window

enemyKits.combo: Slow Grenades / Land Mine zone → R2000 Missile → Make It Rain ult
enemyKits.winCondition: wall off space with mines/grenades and rain artillery on a held enemy
enemyKits.playWith: CC and chokes that force enemies into his zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile turret — flank his mine zones, dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Wild Rush charge → Ruthless Assault → Highland Hurl slow → Unstoppable Force cleanse ult
enemyKits.winCondition: engage Unstoppable and grind with Hersir-empowered swings
enemyKits.passive: Hersir stacks empower the next basic
enemyKits.playAgainst: save CC for after Unstoppable Force; kite her charge
